title: Yellowed Nutty Saudi Arabian Almond Pilaf
description: A comforting Saudi Arabian dish featuring nuts and steam cooked to perfection, this pilaf is both nutty and tender, making it a great keto-friendly option.
instructions: Heat the ghee in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to brown.
Add the sliced almonds and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the basmati rice and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, and salt, and stir to combine.
Add the water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan, and steam the pilaf for 20 minutes.
Turn off the heat and let the pilaf rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
